issue_context.title: DEPR: Index == Series should return NotImplemented
issue_context.body:
ATM `index == series` returns an ndarray because `Index.__eq__` does _not_ return `NotImplemented`.  It isn't clear to me what the reason for this is.  The special casing leads to a non-trivial amount of complexity in the code and especially in the tests.

We should deprecate this special casing.
comments: Discussed on Nov 2020 dev call, decided to hold until we have a BoolIndex

review_comments: here is the another usage with MI as we discussed in another PR. ok to unify this later, just pointing this out. that MI are an odd man out from the rest of the array-likes we have .

API change, yes.  not just DTI, but any `index == series` will now return a Series[bool] instead of ndarray[bool]

hmm then i am no sure I like this api change. We return bool ndarrays on purpose from comparisions to avoid having to align everything. I think this could potentially be a nasty user trap.

My motivation is pretty much "hunt down special cases"
